user_question: Conduct a comprehensive research report on how Generative AI is transforming the healthcare industry in 2025–2026. Analyze medical diagnosis, drug discovery, AI healthcare assistants, patient data privacy, real-world implementations, benefits, risks, and future challenges. Use credible sources, verify important claims, provide citations, identify conflicting or missing evidence, and give a structured conclusion.
short_answer: Generative AI is significantly transforming healthcare through advancements in medical diagnosis, drug discovery, AI healthcare assistants, and patient data privacy, while also presenting challenges related to security and ethical considerations.
key_findings: Generative AI enhances medical diagnosis by improving clinical decision support systems, enabling better diagnostic assistance, and facilitating the interpretation of medical imaging through advanced models like diffusion and transformer architectures.

In drug discovery, generative AI accelerates the design and synthesis of new compounds, optimizing molecular representations and predicting protein structures, which can lead to faster development of new therapies.
